name: Baked Pears with Spiced Caramel Sauce, Whipped Cream & Pumpkin Seeds

instructions.primary_message: Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Wash, dry, quarter, and core pears; medium dice and transfer to a large baking dish.
Dot pears with small pieces of butter and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated). Bake until pears are fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt additional butter in a medium saucepan over low heat.

Once butter is melted, whisk in cream, sugar, honey, and spices. Increase heat to medium and simmer, whisking frequently, until sauce is slightly thickened and glossy, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly to further thicken the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml (½ cup) heavy cream
⅓ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp honey
3 pinch cinnamon
3 pinch nutmeg, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream and sugar into the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
237 ml heavy cream
1 ½ tsp granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Use a whisk (or hand blender) to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 4 minutes if whisking. (When you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
To serve, divide baked pears between bowls; top with caramel sauce, whip cream, and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!
